tools.name: run_aoa_mini_assessment
tools.description: Run a five-question AI opportunity interview or turn supplied answers into one evidence-grounded recommendation. Reuse answered questions. Returns report content and host rendering

tools.name: aoa_ai_opportunity_assessment
tools.description: Start an AI Opportunity Assessment: a mini assessment, a discovery-call guide, or a full assessment from interview notes. Routes each request to the matching AOA tool.

tools.name: create_aoa_discovery_guide
tools.description: Prepare an AOA discovery-call guide: canonical interview questions with original numbers, agenda and notes space. Content only; the host creates the files.

tools.name: run_aoa_full_assessment
tools.description: Analyze AI opportunity interview notes: screen tools, knowledge, skills and workflows; score impact and effort. Returns a draft record and report plan for host review, not files.

tools.name: run_aoa_knowledge_base_assessment
tools.description: Knowledge base assessment from interview notes or five questions. Maps where business knowledge lives, scores value and readiness, plans the first build. Returns content only.
